question: What is something you did as a kid that your parents still don't know about?
story: When I was ten, my parents told me our goldfish died of old age. But here's the thing. I'm the one who killed it. Not on purpose. I wanted to see if goldfish liked orange juice, because you know, orange. So I poured a little splash into the tank. By morning, Bubbles was floating. But here's where it gets worse. My mom blamed my little sister, because she was the last one seen near the tank. My sister cried for a week. She got grounded from dessert. And I said nothing. For fifteen years, I have said nothing. Last Thanksgiving, my sister brought it up, and my whole family laughed about how she killed Bubbles. I laughed too. I'm taking this one to the grave.
